issues.description: In template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp, the methods Bitmap24::resize_buffer(), Bitmap24::save(), and Bitmap24::set() are declared under 'protected', but template_repository/example_program/src/main.cpp calls these methods (e.g., bitmap.resize_buffer(...), bitmap.set(...), bitmap.save(...)). This causes the example_program to fail compilation due to access violations. In the solution repository, these methods are public, confirming they are intended to be callable from main.cpp.
issues.suggestedFix: In template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp, move resize_buffer(), save(), and set() into the public section (matching the solution), or change their access specifier to public.
